item.title: Peso mexicano retrocede levemente tras datos clave inflación EUU
item.description: El peso mexicano se replegó ligeramente el miércoles, arrastrado por un avance global del dólar después de que un dato de inflación en Estados Unidos reforzó la cautela sobre el rumbo de las tasas de interés de la Reserva Federal.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El peso mexicano se replegó ligeramente el miércoles, arrastrado por un [USN:L1N44N0YX TEXT:"avance global del dólar"] después de que un dato de inflación en [USN:L6N44N0QB TEXT:"Estados Unidos"] reforzó la cautela sobre el rumbo de las tasas de interés de la Reserva Federal. En México, el [USN:L1N44N0YS TEXT:"banco central"] elevó su perspectiva de crecimiento económico para este año, pero mantuvo una visión cautelosa sobre la inflación, en su informe trimestral, lo que apunta a una pausa prolongada en la tasa clave de interés. * La moneda local cotizaba en 16.9503 por dólar en la recta final de los negocios, con una depreciación marginal de 0.04%, en su tercera jornada de pérdidas, después de haberse fortalecido el viernes a niveles no vistos desde [USN:L1N44I0Q5 TEXT:"mayo de 2024"]. * En Estados Unidos, el índice de precios del [USN:L8N44N15I TEXT:"gasto en consumo personal"] (PCE) aumentó en julio ligeramente más de lo previsto, tanto en la medición mensual como anual. La lectura redujo el margen para una pronta relajación monetaria de la Fed. * Además, la [USN:L8N44N15E TEXT:"economía estadounidense"] mantuvo una expansión moderada en el segundo trimestre, según una revisión de un cálculo preliminar del Producto Interno Bruto (PIB) ofrecido a finales de julio. * A nivel doméstico, [USN:L1N44N0YS TEXT:"Banco de México"] elevó a un 1.5% su estimación puntual para el crecimiento del PIB de 2026, desde el 1.1% en su proyección anterior. * El índice bursátil S&P/BMV IPC (.MXX) terminó la sesión con una baja de 0.15%, en 66,191.11 puntos, revirtiendo las ganancias que mostró durante buena parte del día y poniendo fin a una racha de cinco jornadas de avances. * Las acciones del gigante de medios Grupo Televisa (TLEVISACPO.MX) encabezaron el retroceso, con un 3.21% menos a 9.66 pesos, seguidas por las del grupo aeroportuario GAP (GAPB.MX) , que restaron un 3.13% a 365.46 pesos. * En el mercado secundario de deuda, el rendimiento del bono gubernamental a 10 años cerró en 9.18%. La tasa del papel a 20 años se ubicó en 9.67%.

item.title: Agilent raises annual profit forecast on improving lab tools demand
item.description: Agilent Technologies raised its annual profit forecast on Wednesday, betting on improving demand for its medical tools and equipment used in lab research and drug development.
item.dc:creator: Bageshri Banerjee
item.content:encoded: Agilent Technologies (A.N) raised its annual profit forecast on Wednesday, betting on improving demand for its medical tools and equipment used in lab research and drug development. Demand conditions are improving for U.S. life sciences and laboratory-equipment companies after a prolonged downturn driven by constrained biotech funding and uneven demand. Agilent now expects an annual adjusted profit of $6.18 to $6.21 per share, compared to its previous forecast of $6 to $6.10 apiece. "We are seeing improving end markets, stronger demand in key regions, and excellent customer response to our innovative product launches," CEO Padraig McDonnell said. Analysts, on average, were expecting revenue of $7.45 billion and an adjusted profit of $6.06 per share for the year, according to data compiled by LSEG. The company's third-quarter revenue rose to $1.88 billion, topping analysts' estimate of $1.84 billion. Its adjusted profit for the quarter ended July 31 was $1.62 per share, including a 6-cent benefit from tariff refunds, compared with an estimated $1.49 per share. Revenue from its CrossLab unit, which offers products and services for laboratory management, rose 6% to $786 million in the quarter.

item.title: US judge blocks Trump overhaul of funding for fair housing groups
item.description: A federal judge on Wednesday blocked President Donald Trump's administration from restructuring a federal grant program to redirect money away from over 100 non-profit organizations that had historically received funding to help prevent and investigate housing discrimination.
item.dc:creator: Nate Raymond
item.content:encoded: A federal judge on Wednesday blocked President Donald Trump's administration from restructuring a federal grant program to redirect money away from over 100 non-profit organizations that had historically received funding to help prevent and investigate housing discrimination. U.S. District Judge Myong Joun in Boston ruled that the U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development had failed to provide a reasoned explanation for its decision to implement "sweeping changes" to a decades-old grant program run by the agency designed to combat housing discrimination. HUD did not respond to a request for comment. The judge, an appointee of Democratic President Joe Biden, said that Congress had long recognized the need to provide funding for fair housing organizations to help support the work of HUD, which had funded them through multi-year grants. Yet he said HUD in July upended that system of enforcing the Fair Housing Act by announcing it would not allocate any of its congressionally appropriated funding for the 2025 fiscal year to private enforcement initiatives or to multi-year grants issued through the Fair Housing Initiatives Program, which Congress created in 1987. In the past, HUD would typically award over 100 grants ranging from $75,000 to $425,000, according to lawyers for several fair housing groups, including the National Fair Housing Alliance that sued over the changes in July. HUD instead planned to use $46 million of the $56 million that Congress had appropriated for just five grants, $25 million of which would go to a law school. The remaining $10 million could go to a state or local agency. "The effect of HUD’s restructure effectively bars the very housing organizations that have been effectuating FHIP’s mission year after year since its enactment," Joun said. The Trump administration also sought to force grant recipients to sign onto unrelated conditions to receive funding, by imposing requirements that they not use any funding to support "gender ideology" or "illegal immigration." HUD had argued it had the discretion to impose those conditions and that the changes it was making to the grant program were part of a large-scale modernization effort designed to broaden participation. But Joun said that "pithy description falls woefully short of the mark in both form and substance," and that it was "hard to see how or where Defendants relied on relevant data in crafting these changes."

item.title: Yankees place struggling RHP Fernando Cruz (elbow) on IL
item.description: The New York Yankees placed right-hander Fernando Cruz on the 15-day injured list Wednesday due to elbow discomfort in his pitching arm.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The New York Yankees placed right-hander Fernando Cruz on the 15-day injured list Wednesday due to elbow discomfort in his pitching arm. Cruz has struggled since the All-Star break and he served up a two-run homer to Houston's Jeremy Pena in Tuesday's 9-7 home loss to the Astros. After the contest, reporters noted that Cruz left the clubhouse with a team trainer. Cruz, 36, sported a stellar 2.20 ERA after tossing a scoreless inning against the Los Angeles Dodgers on July 17. Since then, he has served up five homers and walked 10 in 13 2/3 innings while allowing nine earned runs for a 5.93 ERA during the span. Overall, Cruz is 4-6 with two saves and a 3.13 ERA in 61 appearances this season. He is in his second season in New York after spending the previous three with the Cincinnati Reds. Cruz is 11-21 with four saves and a 4.03 ERA in 251 big league appearances (seven starts). The Yankees also optioned right-hander Bradley Hanner to Triple-A Scranton/Wilkes-Barre, recalled right-hander Elmer Rodriguez from the same affiliate and signed right-hander Michael Fulmer and added him to the active roster. New York transferred right-hander Kervin Castro (elbow) to the 60-day injured list to open a 40-man roster spot for Fulmer. Hanner, 27, had a 6.75 ERA in three appearances with New York in his first action in the majors. Rodriguez, 23, received his first big-league opportunities earlier this season when he went 0-2 with a 4.76 ERA in four starts. Fulmer, 33, was designated for assignment by the Los Angeles Angels on Sunday. He cleared waivers and subsequently chose to be a free agent on Tuesday and the Yankees opted to take a chance on him. He was American League Rookie of the Year in 2016 and an All-Star with the Detroit Tigers in 2017 before two major arm surgeries derailed his career. Fulmer is 37-50 with 19 saves and a 3.92 ERA in 268 appearances (90 starts) with five teams over nine seasons. Fulmer gave up two hits over 3 2/3 scoreless innings in three appearances for the Angels. --Field Level Media

item.title: Nvidia forecasts quarterly revenue above estimates
item.description: Nvidia forecast quarterly revenue above Wall Street estimates on Wednesday, but its outlook did little to ease investor concerns about the company's long-term dominance in the AI chip market.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Nvidia (NVDA.O) forecast quarterly revenue above Wall Street estimates on Wednesday, but its outlook did little to ease investor concerns about the company's long-term dominance in the AI chip market. Shares of the world's most valuable company fell 1.2% in extended trading. As of Tuesday's close, Nvidia has gained just 14.2% so far this year, while AMD and Intel have more than doubled. The company expects third-quarter revenue of $108.0 billion, plus or minus 2%, compared with analysts' average estimate of $104.19 billion, according to data compiled by LSEG. Nvidia said it did not assume any data center chip sales from China in its outlook. Results from Nvidia, one of the world's most valuable firms, are considered a bellwether for the AI market as its chips power most of the major data centers and advanced AI models globally. The report comes weeks after companies including Microsoft (MSFT.O) and Meta (META.O) — two of Nvidia's biggest customers — reinforced expectations that Big Tech would spend [USN:L4N43X10O TEXT:"more than $730 billion"] on AI infrastructure this year, an unprecedented sum that marks a big step up from last year's $400 billion outlay. An increasing share of tech companies' slated spending is now, however, going towards in-house chip efforts that aim to reduce their reliance on Nvidia's costly and supply-constrained processors. Scrutiny has also mounted of Nvidia's role in the AI boom's complex financing ecosystem after it agreed to guarantee some deals under a [USN:L4N4471A6 TEXT:"new tie-up with six major financial institutions"] that aims to raise more than $500 billion for AI infrastructure. As AI is increasingly used to automate tasks and answer queries, Nvidia's graphics processors face growing competition from central processors and custom chips that are better suited to handle that process — known as inference. Rivals Intel (INTC.O) and AMD (AMD.O) are also targeting the inference market and several Chinese firms including Baidu (9888.HK) already produce their own chips for such tasks. Nvidia has taken notice. In March, it [USN:L1N4040KN TEXT:"unveiled"] a new central processor and AI system based on technology licensed from inference-focused startup Groq in a $17 billion deal, pairing Groq's chips with its upcoming Vera Rubin platform. The company's dominance as the AI market leader was reinforced earlier this month when SpaceX (SPCX.O) CEO Elon Musk said the rocket firm would [USN:L4N4411XL TEXT:"exclusively use Nvidia's hardware"]. Nvidia has said the revenue opportunity for its AI chips could exceed [USN:L1N4040KN TEXT:"$1 trillion through 2027"], doubling from the $500 billion opportunity through 2026 that Nvidia cited for its Blackwell and Rubin chips.

item.title: HP forecasts strong fourth-quarter profit on price hikes, US tariff refunds
item.description: HP HPQ.N forecast current-quarter profit above Wall Street estimates on Wednesday, a sign that estimated tariff refunds along with price increases on premium and AI-powered personal computers will offset memory chip expenses.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: HP <HPQ.N> forecast current-quarter profit above Wall Street estimates on Wednesday, a sign that estimated tariff refunds along with price increases on premium and AI-powered personal computers will offset memory chip expenses. The company expects fourth-quarter adjusted earnings per share between 69 cents and 79 cents, above analysts' average estimate of 67 cents, according to data compiled by LSEG. The forecast includes an 8-cent boost from estimated tariff refunds. U.S. President Donald Trump's administration has refunded about [USN:L1N4421MY TEXT:"$100 billion from tariffs"] it collected before the U.S. Supreme Court struck down those duties, a court filing showed earlier this month. HP, like peers Dell Technologies (DELL.N) , Apple (AAPL.O) and China's Lenovo Group (0992.HK) , raised prices for its devices as a global shortage of memory chips drove up costs. HP reported third-quarter revenue of $15.7 billion, up 12.5% from a year earlier and exceeding estimates of $14.38 billion, helped by strong demand for [USN:L6N4290MI TEXT:"AI-optimized PCs"]. "In the third quarter, we increased both total sales and share in premium products and continued to attract new customers with innovations in WXP, Print, workstations and AI PCs," HP's interim CEO, Bruce Broussard, said. "Our ongoing strategy to address environmental constraints led to meaningful improvements in memory supply and higher fulfillment rates." Rival [USN:L1N44A047 TEXT:"Lenovo reported a 43% jump"] in quarterly revenue earlier in August, benefiting from an AI hardware boom and price hikes due to the memory chip shortage. HP's adjusted profit of 83 cents per share for the quarter ended July 31 also included a boost of 11 cents a share from tariff refunds. The adjusted earnings beat estimates of 69 cents per share. It also raised its annual forecast for adjusted earnings per share to a range of $3.19 to $3.29, which includes a $0.19 favorable impact from estimated tariff refunds for the entire year. The laptop maker had earlier forecast annual adjusted EPS to be $2.90 to $3.10.

item.title: How Meta’s AI workforce transformation plans went kaput
item.description: Ask just about anyone in Silicon Valley and they’ll tell you that AI is coming for their jobs. Software coders laboring to improve AI are effectively working to make their jobs obsolete.
item.dc:creator: Greg Bensinger
item.content:encoded: Ask just about anyone in Silicon Valley and they’ll tell you that AI is coming for their jobs. Software coders laboring to improve AI are effectively working to make their jobs obsolete. The doomsaying is not just idle talk. Some 113,000 job cuts have been tied to AI this year, according to executive search firm Challenger, Gray and Christmas. Amazon (AMZN.O) [USN:L4N3W90R8 TEXT:"gave AI credit"] for a big chunk of its 30,000-worker reduction starting last October. Jack Dorsey, CEO of Square-parent Block, said a February [USN:L4N3ZM2BA TEXT:"40% cut to staff"] was because AI “fundamentally changes what it means to build and run a company.” PayPal (PYPL.O) sent nearly 5,000 workers packing in May to “accelerate AI adoption and automation.” The list goes on. [USN:L4N4041JJ TEXT:"Dell"] (DELL.N) , [USN:L4N43U1FQ TEXT:"Visa"] (V.N) , [USN:L1N3YL100 TEXT:"Citigroup"] (C.N) and [USN:FWN41X0G8 TEXT:"Intuit"] (INTU.O) are among dozens of others pulling back on paying people in favor of paying for greater AI use. Corporations have been particularly encouraged by emerging AI software that can perform functions autonomously, known as agents, and so-called vibe coding software that can spin up new websites, apps and other services with a minimum of human input. The exuberance over job cuts can be traced back, at least in part, to Elon Musk’s gutting of Twitter, now X, when he took it private in 2022. The billionaire eventually laid off about four out of every five workers at the social media firm and, to some technologists’ astonishment, maintained a largely functioning website. Not all of the jobs lost can be attributed to workers competing directly with software. Many firms are committing massive capital expenditures toward building out infrastructure, such as data centers and chip manufacturing, necessary to keep the wheels of AI spinning around the clock. The money has to come from somewhere. Oracle (ORCL.N) , for instance, shed 21,000 jobs in its fiscal 2026, citing infrastructure as a primary driver. Microsoft (MSFT.O) axed about 4,800 workers, primarily in its Xbox game division, to help fund its AI ambitions. Many of these same companies are reporting ballooning profits and sales. Take Meta (META.O) , for instance. The Facebook and Instagram parent boosted its net income in this year’s first six months by 22%. It was also busy contesting allegations in [USN:L6N44A1AM TEXT:"federal court"] this month that it made its products addictive for teenagers, before reaching a [USN:L6N44N0QU TEXT:"$17 billion settlement"]. CEO Mark Zuckerberg drew up a secret plan to cut some teams by as much as 60% in an effort to make his workforce “AI native,” my colleague Katie Paul reports. Read on to learn how the effort, known as Project OT, failed to launch. OUR LATEST REPORTING ON TECH AND AI Mark Zuckerberg had a bold plan to replace Meta staff with AI. It imploded. [USN:L6N44N0VA TEXT:"Meta agrees to pay $18 billion to settle US lawsuits over children's social media addiction"] [USN:L6N44M0VW TEXT:"Instagram head Mosseri, at children’s addiction trial, says few teenagers knew of safety feature"] [USN:L6N44I0Y6 TEXT:"The AI founders who walked away from Bezos-backed Prometheus to model the universe"] [USN:L1N44M11G TEXT:"AI-generated music barred from Australian charts after Madonna cover controversy"] [USN:L6N44I0TK TEXT:"Nvidia shares set for $280 billion price swing after earnings, options show"] [USN:L1N44407T TEXT:"China's Moonshot in talks with Microsoft, Amazon, Google over K3 revenue sharing, sources say"] [USN:L6N44I0TK TEXT:"China's Robot Olympics ends with humanoid's 8.64-second 100m, faster than Bolt "] WORKER BACKLASH Meta’s plan was perhaps the most ambitious AI workforce overhaul attempted by a big corporate player to date, making it a bellwether case for how far the technology can be pushed. If Project OT had succeeded, Zuckerberg would have created a template for the future of work, much as Henry Ford did at the tail end of the Industrial Revolution or as tech CEOs did a generation ago in convincing other executives to embrace jeans and ping-pong tables in offices.For now, however, his vision has been a dud. Not to be outdone by rivals, Meta pared around 10% of its employees in May, but called off plans for a second “wave” of the restructuring the night before those layoffs, Paul reported, citing internal documents, interviews and recordings. The Menlo Park, California, company has said it expects to invest $130 billion or more in AI infrastructure and chips this year alone. The plan included breaking down teams into “pods” with fewer employees and less management to move faster. AI tools would enable those small pods “to explore more ideas with less cost and higher fidelity,” wrote one executive in an internal memo. Human resources was enlisted to find employees who were irreplaceable and could, alone, do the work of 10 corporate employees, supercharged in part by AI. But Meta’s real human employees staged something of a revolt, affronted by a host of internal AI efforts that had gone sideways (not to mention Reuters reports informing them of the coming layoffs long before executives intended for them to know). Among them was Meta’s intent to log employees’ keystrokes and mouse movements to inform its AI programs. The firm’s AI agents and coding tools were also causing reliability and security problems, and not boosting employee productivity as much as expected. Zuckerberg said in a Meta town hall last month that agentic tech was not proceeding at the pace he had hoped, though he added that he believed it would improve in the next three to six months. In response to the reporting, Meta acknowledged the existence of Project OT and said the plan encompassed reassigning some workers and would not impact all teams at the company, calling it a “scenario planning exercise.” Ultimately, Zuckerberg scaled back Project OT, which stands for Organization Transformation. He’ll likely be looking for other ways to transform the organization’s workforce in the coming months.

item.title: Falcons' QB1 battle open despite Michael Penix Jr. sitting out preseason
item.description: Michael Penix Jr. is still in contention to start at quarterback for the Atlanta Falcons in their season opener despite missing the entire preseason as he recovers from an ACL tear, Falcons coach Kevin Stefanski said on Wednesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Michael Penix Jr. is still in contention to start at quarterback for the Atlanta Falcons in their season opener despite missing the entire preseason as he recovers from an ACL tear, Falcons coach Kevin Stefanski said on Wednesday. Stefanski said Penix will sit out the team's preseason finale against the Miami Dolphins on Friday. Tua Tagovailoa, who was signed as a free agent in the offseason to compete with Penix, will start against his former team. Backups Cooper Rush and Jack Strand also will see playing time, Stefanski said. The Falcons' first-year head coach said he would not speculate about Week 1 and plans to name a starter "whenever they tell me I have to, when that depth chart has to be put out." "I'm honestly not trying to be coy," Stefanski said. "We will focus on what information is available to us. Every day you're just trying to make decisions on who is available to you." Penix, 26, was medically cleared for 11-on-11 work late last week and returned to full team practice on Monday. He is recovering from knee surgery after suffering the ACL tear in November. "I am best served, and we're best served, (by) keeping it day to day," Stefanski said. "This was an important week for Mike, the first time with people around him. I thought it was a really good first step for him, but outside of this week, I don't think it's fair to go beyond that." Penix sounded comfortable with the timetable, saying that he just got cleared and has three days of 11-on-11 practice. "Not everybody will say it, but anytime it's your first time out there 11-on-11, it's moving fast," he said. "You have to slow that down and get more reps and get comfortable. ... Let me get my feet wet a little bit." Penix said he feels great and will be ready should he be named the starter for the Sept. 13 opener against the Pittsburgh Steelers. "Each and every day, I am getting more confident," he said. "As long as I keep on the track that I'm on, I definitely feel like I will be where I need to be physically and mentally to be confident going out there Week 1." Penix, a first-round pick (eighth overall) in 2024 by Atlanta, has completed 59.6 percent of his passes for 2,757 yards, 12 touchdowns and six interceptions over 14 games (12 starts) in his career. Tagovailoa, 28, signed a veteran-minimum one-year, $1.215 million contract with the Falcons in March after he was released by the Dolphins, who took a nearly $100 million salary-cap hit over the next two seasons by cutting him. The 2020 first-round pick (fifth overall) completed 68 percent of his passes for 18,166 yards, 120 touchdowns and 59 interceptions over six seasons with Miami. --Field Level Media

item.title: Índices fecham praticamente estáveis após dados preocupantes sobre inflação, antes dos resultados da Nvidia
item.description: Os principais índices de Wall Street fecharam praticamente estáveis ou em leve queda nesta quarta-feira, após os dados de inflação dos EUA terem ficado acima do esperado, enquanto muitos investidores mantiveram uma postura cautelosa à espera da divulgação dos resultados financeiros da Nvidia, empresa líder no setor de IA, no final do dia.
item.dc:creator: Saeed Azhar, Purvi Agarwal, Niket Nishant
item.content:encoded: Os principais índices de Wall Street fecharam praticamente estáveis ou em leve queda nesta quarta-feira, após os dados de inflação dos EUA terem ficado acima do esperado, enquanto muitos investidores mantiveram uma postura cautelosa à espera da divulgação dos resultados financeiros da Nvidia, empresa líder no setor de IA, no final do dia. Um relatório do Departamento de Comércio mostrou que a inflação anual dos EUA aumentou 3,7% nos 12 meses até julho, um pouco acima das expectativas. Dados separados indicaram que a economia cresceu 1,5% no segundo trimestre. Os dados mais recentes acrescentaram mais uma complicação às perspectivas de política monetária do Federal Reserve, aumentando a importância dos próximos dados econômicos. Os investidores estarão com os olhos voltados para o discurso do chair do Fed, Kevin Warsh, em Jackson Hole, na sexta-feira. “Não foi o suficiente para alterar o equilíbrio para a reunião de setembro, mas se os dados subsequentes apontarem na mesma direção, o Fed pode sentir mais pressão para sair da neutralidade”, disse Ellen Zentner, estrategista-chefe de economia da Morgan Stanley Wealth Management. A próxima reunião agendada do banco central é em setembro, colocando a decisão de política monetária em foco durante o que historicamente é um mês fraco para o mercado de ações. As chances de um aumento da taxa de juros nessa reunião estão em 38,1%, de acordo com a ferramenta CME FedWatch. De acordo com dados preliminares, o S&P 500 (.SPX) teve variação negativa de 0,01%, fechando em 7.676,29 pontos, enquanto o Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) oscilou 0,06% para baixo, a 26.136,18 pontos. O Dow Jones Industrial Average (.DJI) caiu 0,21%, para 53.463,88 pontos.

item.title: Salesforce raises annual revenue forecasts on AI product momentum
item.description: Salesforce raised its annual revenue forecast on Wednesday, signaling confidence that enterprise adoption of its new AI-powered autonomous agents will accelerate sales.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Salesforce (CRM.N) raised its annual revenue forecast on Wednesday, signaling confidence that enterprise adoption of its new AI-powered autonomous agents will accelerate sales. Shares of the San Francisco-based company rose 7% in extended trading. The forecast suggest that Salesforce is gaining traction with AI-powered tools and autonomous agents that can automate sales, service, and marketing tasks — an area the company sees as a major growth driver for the future. "We're seeing incredible demand for our AI and data products, with annual recurring revenue about to cross $4 billion," said CEO Marc Benioff. The company now expects fiscal 2027 revenue between $46.1 billion and $46.4 billion, compared with its prior outlook of $45.9 billion to $46.2 billion. It also raised its annual adjusted earnings per share forecast to be between $16.67 and $16.71 from its earlier outlook range of $14.06 to $14.12 apiece.

item.title: Abecip eleva previsão de alta do crédito imobiliário em 2026
item.description: A Associação Brasileira das Entidades de Crédito Imobiliário e Poupança (Abecip) elevou nesta quarta-feira sua estimativa de crescimento do crédito imobiliário brasileiro em 2026, após resultado recorde nos financiamentos com recursos das cadernetas de poupança no mês passado.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A Associação Brasileira das Entidades de Crédito Imobiliário e Poupança (Abecip) elevou nesta quarta-feira sua estimativa de crescimento do crédito imobiliário brasileiro em 2026, após resultado recorde nos financiamentos com recursos das cadernetas de poupança no mês passado. A entidade agora calcula uma expansão de 25%, de 16% antes, o que aponta para aproximadamente R$411 bilhões em concessões no ano, de R$ 375 bilhões anteriormente. Para os financiamentos realizados especificamente com recursos do Sistema Brasileiro de Poupança e Empréstimo (SBPE), a expectativa passou de crescimento de 15% para 18% em 2026, com volume próximo de R$185 bilhões. Na avaliação da Abecip, fatores como emprego e renda continuam contribuindo para sustentar a demanda habitacional, enquanto o nível das taxas de juros permanece como um dos principais pontos de atenção para a evolução das concessões nos próximos meses. Em julho, os financiamentos imobiliários com recursos das cadernetas de poupança somaram R$20,96 bilhões, melhor resultado para o mês na série histórica e um salto de 76,7% em relação ao mesmo período de 2025. Ante junho, o montante representa um avanço de 21%. No mês passado, foram financiadas aquisições e construções de 57,9 mil imóveis, crescimento de 61,2% ante o mesmo intervalo do ano passado e de 18,8% em relação a junho. No acumulado dos primeiros sete meses do ano, os financiamentos imobiliários com recursos do SBPE totalizaram R$115,5 bilhões, expansão de 36,3% ano a ano. No período, foram financiados 337,8 mil imóveis nas modalidades de aquisição e construção, aumento de 37,1% na comparação com o mesmo período de 2025. No caso das operações de financiamento imobiliário com recursos livres, houve queda de 57,7% ano a ano, mas alta de 12,7% na comparação mensal, para R$1,32 bilhão. Os recursos foram usados para operações envolvendo 7,3 mil imóveis - retração de 60% ano a ano, mas alta de 11% em relação a junho. Nos primeiros sete meses do ano, essas operações tiveram queda de 26% ante o mesmo período de 2025, para R$9,84 bilhões, com os financiamentos envolvendo 53,7 mil unidades, queda de 28,4%.

item.title: Trump signs order banning some foreign equipment from US energy grid
item.description: President Donald Trump signed an executive order on Wednesday declaring a national emergency and banning the use of some foreign equipment in the U.S. electricity grid, the White House said.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: President Donald Trump signed an executive order on Wednesday declaring a national emergency and banning the use of some foreign equipment in the U.S. electricity grid, the White House said. The order cites what the White House described as an "unusual and extraordinary foreign threat" posed by foreign-made bulk-power systems that may present national security vulnerabilities. Trump's order, the latest example of Washington's approach to tackling [USN:L6N43116K TEXT:"technology threats"] posed by China, follows a decision by the European Commission earlier this year to ban Chinese-made inverters from publicly funded energy projects. Last year, Reuters reported that rogue communication devices not listed in product documents had been found in some Chinese solar power inverters by U.S. experts who strip down equipment hooked up to grids to check for security issues. "I ... find that the situation with respect to the foreign supply of bulk-power system electric equipment constitutes an unusual and extraordinary threat, which has its source in whole or substantial part outside the United States, to the national security, foreign policy, and economy of the United States and hereby declare a national emergency with respect to that threat," Trump said in the order. Under the order, certain foreign-produced bulk-power system electric equipment, including associated critical software and digital capabilities that could pose cybersecurity or operational risks, will be barred from being purchased or installed in the United States, the White House said in a statement. The order also asks the U.S. Energy Secretary to impose conditions on the continued use and operation of such equipment to address concerns identified by the Trump administration, the White House added.

item.title: Brasil eleva previsión sobre proporción de deuda vinculada a las tasas de interés a un máximo histórico este año
item.description: El Ministerio de Hacienda de Brasil reveló el miércoles un deterioro del perfil de la deuda pública este año, y prevé que la parte vinculada a la tasa de interés de referencia Selic podría alcanzar un máximo histórico del 53%.
item.dc:creator: Marcela Ayres
item.content:encoded: El Ministerio de Hacienda de Brasil reveló el miércoles un deterioro del perfil de la deuda pública este año, y prevé que la parte vinculada a la tasa de interés de referencia Selic podría alcanzar un máximo histórico del 53%. Al haber más pasivos vinculados a tasas variables, el aumento de los costos de financiación se traduce directamente en una mayor acumulación de deuda. Aunque el Banco Central de Brasil comenzó a relajar su política monetaria en marzo, la tasa de referencia se mantiene en el 14%, mientras que la inflación a 12 meses se situaba en el 4,2% a mediados de agosto, lo que deja al país con una de las tasas de interés reales más altas entre las principales economías. La nueva previsión del Tesoro se incluyó en su plan de financiación anual revisado, que prevé que la deuda a tasa variable represente entre el 49% y el 53% del total este año, frente a una previsión anterior del 46% al 50%. Dicha proporción aumentó hasta el 51,1% en julio. La mayor economía de América Latina financia una parte inusualmente grande de su deuda mediante bonos a tasa variable, una herramienta diseñada para mantener la demanda de los inversionistas durante períodos de tensión en los mercados. El Ministerio de Hacienda ha recurrido en mayor medida a estos instrumentos ante el escaso interés por los títulos indexados a la inflación, a pesar de ofrecer rendimientos reales superiores al 7% en bonos a muy largo plazo. "El aumento de la proporción de valores a tasa variable en la deuda pública federal refleja una combinación de mayor volatilidad y tasas de interés elevadas, lo que contribuye a que los inversionistas prefieran instrumentos de menor duración que sean menos sensibles a las fluctuaciones de las tasas de interés", señaló el Ministerio de Hacienda en un comunicado. Asimismo, rebajó su previsión para la deuda indexada a la inflación del 23%-27% anterior al 21%-25% del total, mientras que la proporción prevista de valores a tasa fija se redujo del 21%-25% al 20%-24%. La deuda indexada a divisas se mantenía en el 3%-7%. Este cambio se conoce en un contexto de turbulencias en los mercados globales y de preocupación por las perspectivas fiscales de Brasil, donde la deuda pública bruta -el principal indicador de solvencia del país- ha alcanzado el 81,9% del PIB, lo que supone un aumento de más de 10 puntos porcentuales desde que el presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva asumió el cargo. Las previsiones actualizadas se publicaron junto con los datos de deuda pública de julio, que mostraron un aumento del saldo de la deuda federal del 0,22% respecto al mes anterior, a 9,289 billones de reales (1,8 billones de dólares). (1 dólar = 5,1550 reales)

item.title: US Army awards up to $2.2 billion to five companies to build microreactors on bases
item.description: The U.S. Army said on Wednesday it is awarding up to $2.2 billion to five companies to build and operate tiny nuclear reactors on military bases, which it hopes will one day power remote installations.
item.dc:creator: Timothy Gardner, Mike Stone
item.content:encoded: The U.S. Army said on Wednesday it is awarding up to $2.2 billion to five companies to build and operate tiny nuclear reactors on military bases, which it hopes will one day power remote installations. So-called microreactors are tiny factory-built nuclear plants that developers say will be easily transported and generate up to 20 megawatts of power each. The Army believes that developing them through a program called Janus could one day help power remote military installations such as those in Alaska or on islands. The program has a goal of deploying the first reactor by September 2028. The companies and bases the Army selected were: Antares Nuclear Inc in Fort Bragg, North Carolina BWXT Advanced Technologies LLC in Fort Campbell, Kentucky General Atomics Electromagnetic Systems in Fort Hood, Texas Radiant Industries Inc in Fort Benning, Georgia Westinghouse Government Services in Fort Drum, New York The Army did not detail how much money would be distributed to each company. But Radiant said it will get up to $750 million to develop and deploy 15 of its Kaleidos reactors in the program. An Army official said reactors will have to follow all environmental and safety rules that apply to commercial reactors but added that they would be regulated by the Army, not the U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission, which regulates commercial reactors. "The whole idea here is that at the back end of this we want a commercial product," said Jeff Waksman, the principal deputy assistant secretary of the Army for Installations, Energy and Environment. Radiant's Chief Commercial Officer Mike Starrett told Reuters in an interview that the Janus award is key to the company scaling up its business to eventually meet the needs of commercial customers like data centers in about 2030. Critics of microreactors say they will be expensive compared to conventional reactors. Waksman said nobody thinks that microreactors will be lower in cost than conventional plants. "What we are trying to do here with Janus ... is to flesh out how can we get those prices down," Waksman said. The military currently pays about 40 cents a kilowatt hour to power Arctic installations, costs it hopes to cut, Waksman said. The Army also expects that the private sector will raise more money for the reactors than the federal government and the program will help attract that capital. Starrett said that because Radiant's containerized reactors can be brought to the customer, eliminating energy transmission fees, their delivered cost will be between 20 and 30 cents per kilowatt hour.

item.title: St George fecha acordo para centro de processamento de terras raras de R$2 bi em MG
item.description: A mineradora australiana St George Mining assinou nesta quarta-feira um protocolo de intenções com o grupo brasileiro Lima & Pergher para desenvolver um centro de separação e processamento de terras raras em Uberlândia (MG), em um projeto estimado em R$2 bilhões, disseram executivos à Reuters, durante evento do setor em Belo Horizonte.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A mineradora australiana St George Mining (SGQ.AX) assinou nesta quarta-feira um protocolo de intenções com o grupo brasileiro Lima & Pergher para desenvolver um centro de separação e processamento de terras raras em Uberlândia (MG), em um projeto estimado em R$2 bilhões, disseram executivos à Reuters, durante evento do setor em Belo Horizonte. A unidade deverá ser instalada no complexo industrial da START, divisão química e industrial do Grupo Lima & Pergher, e tem previsão de iniciar operação comercial até 2030, após estudos de viabilidade técnica e econômica. A expectativa é que o centro seja concebido para processar carbonatos de terras raras a serem produzidos pelo projeto Araxá, da própria St George, em Araxá (MG), além de material potencialmente fornecido por outras mineradoras.

item.title: Freddy Peralta earns first Rays win as AL East leaders blank Tigers
item.description: Freddy Peralta pitched six strong innings and recorded his first win since being traded to Tampa Bay as the Rays defeated the host Detroit Tigers 3-0 on Wednesday afternoon.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Freddy Peralta pitched six strong innings and recorded his first win since being traded to Tampa Bay as the Rays defeated the host Detroit Tigers 3-0 on Wednesday afternoon. Peralta, Kevin Kelly and Tyler Wells combined on a two-hitter for the American League East leaders. Peralta (6-11) struck out four in his fifth start since the Rays acquired him from the New York Mets on Aug. 2. Kelly pitched the seventh and eighth innings, while Wells got the last three outs for his fifth save. Jonny DeLuca drove in a run and scored another, while Jonathan Aranda had two hits and scored a run. Liam Hicks and Cedric Mullins drove in the other runs for Tampa Bay. Junior Caminero added two hits as the Rays took two of three games in the series. Detroit starter Troy Melton (7-3) gave up all three runs on seven hits in seven innings. He also struck out four. The Tigers, who have lost seven of their last eight games, were shut out for the first time since the All-Star break. Neither team drew a walk in a game that lasted just two hours and two minutes. The Rays grabbed a 2-0 lead in the second. Chandler Simpson led off with an infield single and scored on DeLuca's double to left. Following a sacrifice and a strikeout, Mullins pulled a single down the right-field line to bring home DeLuca. Mullins overslid second base trying to stretch the hit into a double and was tagged out. Tampa Bay extended its lead to 3-0 in the sixth. Aranda led off with a double and moved to third on a single by Caminero. Hicks hit a ball to the warning track in right field for a sacrifice fly to bring in Aranda. Brett Callahan had a two-out single, the Tigers' second hit of the game, in the bottom of the inning. Peralta challenged a ball call on the next batter and it was overturned, resulting in a Kevin McGonigle strikeout. Detroit's only other hit was Dillon Dingler's bloop single in the second inning. --Field Level Media

item.title: Apple lançará próximo iPhone em 9 de setembro
item.description: A Apple vai realizar seu próximo evento de lançamento de produtos em 9 de setembro, quando o mercado espera que a empresa revele uma nova série de iPhones com um modelo com tela dobrável.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A Apple (AAPL.O) vai realizar seu próximo evento de lançamento de produtos em 9 de setembro, quando o mercado espera que a empresa revele uma nova série de iPhones com um modelo com tela dobrável. O lançamento também marcará o primeiro grande evento do novo presidente-executivo da Apple, John Ternus. Ternus, que há muito tempo é chefe de hardware da Apple, deve assumir o comando da empresa em 1º de setembro, enquanto Tim Cook passa a ocupar o cargo de presidente executivo do conselho de administração. A nomeação de Ternus, anunciada em abril, foi amplamente vista como um sinal do renovado empenho da Apple em aproveitar seu principal ponto forte: os dispositivos. Atualmente, a Samsung Electronics (005930.KS) domina o nicho crescente de smartphones dobráveis, segmento em que as empresas apostam que em breve se tornará o principal do setor, apesar dos elevados preços dos aparelhos. Analistas esperam que a Apple lance um iPhone com tela dobrável e de tamanho semelhante ao do iPad mini. No início deste ano, a Samsung revelou um novo celular dobrável do tamanho de um passaporte. A Apple deve vender mais de 17 milhões de iPhones dobráveis até 2027, de acordo com a empresa de pesquisa de mercado IDC. A IDC espera alta de 12,6% nas vendas de telefones dobráveis este ano. Em comparação, as vendas globais de smartphones devem recuar 16,7%. No ano passado, a Apple revelou um iPhone Air mais fino e equipou os modelos básicos do iPhone 17 com vários recursos aprimorados. A linha do iPhone 17 ajudou a impulsionar um forte ciclo de atualização de aparelhos entre os consumidores da marca. (Por Deborah Sophia)

item.title: Vídeo de obra de ferrovia atribuída ao governo Lula foi feito com IA
item.description: Um vídeo da suposta construção de uma ferrovia pelo governo do presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva foi produzido com IA.
item.dc:creator: Reuters Fact Check
item.content:encoded: Um vídeo da suposta construção de uma ferrovia pelo governo do presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva foi produzido com IA. Aqui estão os principais detalhes: O conteúdo foi publicado no Facebook, no Instagram e no Threads. O vídeo mostra a construção de uma ferrovia sobre um campo e a passagem de um trem. “Lula não para de trabalhar”, diz a legenda. “Construção da Ferrovia Norte-Sul. Aí o trecho Maranhão-Pará, sobre o rio Tocantins. Mais de 10 mil empregos”, afirma a narração. Uma análise feita pela ferramenta SynthID , do Google, indicou que o vídeo foi gerado com uso de uma IA da empresa. O SynthID consegue detectar a presença de uma marca d’água embutida de forma oculta em imagens criadas ou modificadas por modelos de IA da companhia. A construção da Ferrovia Norte-Sul teve início em 1987. Atualmente, 2.200km da ferrovia estão concluídos e em funcionamento. Quando estiver totalmente pronta, a obra terá 4.155km, indo do Pará ao Rio Grande do Sul. O trecho entre Maranhão e Pará corresponde ao traçado entre Açailândia (MA) e Barcarena (PA), cujas obras ainda não começaram. O leilão da concessão deve ocorrer em 2027 . Além disso, o trecho não corta o rio Tocantins (página 7 do documento ), como dizem os posts. Veredicto: Mídia sintética. Imagens de uma suposta ferrovia sendo construída pelo governo Lula foram produzidas com IA. Este artigo foi produzido pela equipe da Reuters Fact Check. item.title: Austin Hill to race in Cup Series full-time for RCR in 2027
item.description: Austin Hill will race full-time in the No. 33 car in the NASCAR Cup Series in 2027, Richard Childress Racing announced.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Austin Hill will race full-time in the No. 33 car in the NASCAR Cup Series in 2027, Richard Childress Racing announced. Hill has 16 combined wins while qualifying for the Chase in each of the past five seasons driving RCR's No. 21 in the NASCAR O'Reilly Auto Parts Series. He has also run 15 Cup races this season, but has yet to record a top-10 finish. Hill had raced in two Cup races earlier this year before taking over the No. 33 following Kyle Busch's death. "Austin Hill is a talented race car driver and his continued growth, work ethic and success across multiple levels of NASCAR competition have positioned him for his next step with RCR," chairman and CEO Richard Childress said. "He's put a tremendous amount of effort into his career, especially this year with everything he's taken on. We've watched Austin grow as a driver and as a person, and we're proud to have him continue that growth with RCR in the NASCAR Cup Series." Hill, 32, is originally from Winston, Ga., and previously owned Austin Hill Racing that competed in the NASCAR Craftsman Truck Series and ARCA Menards Series from 2013-17. "I'm extremely thankful to Richard and everyone at RCR for believing in me and giving me this opportunity," Hill said. "Every race car driver dreams of competing full time in the NASCAR Cup Series, and to have that opportunity with RCR is something I don't take for granted." --Field Level Media

item.title: Temasek-backed Sembcorp's India renewables unit files for $393 million IPO
item.description: Sembcorp Green Infra, the Indian renewable energy arm of Temasek-backed Sembcorp Industries , has filed for an initial public offering in Mumbai to raise up to 37.5 billion rupees ($393.04 million), draft papers dated Wednesday showed.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Sembcorp Green Infra, the Indian renewable energy arm of Temasek-backed Sembcorp Industries (SCIL.SI) , has filed for an initial public offering in Mumbai to raise up to 37.5 billion rupees ($393.04 million), draft papers dated Wednesday showed. The filing marks Sembcorp's [USN:Ifp9gWxCq TEXT:"second attempt"] to take its Indian energy business public and comes as India's IPO market sees signs of revival after a muted first half of the year. In 2018, the company, then known as Sembcorp Energy India, filed draft papers before withdrawing them a year later, saying it was injecting new equity into the business. The IPO consists entirely of new shares, with Sembcorp Industries, which fully owns the company, not selling any shares. About 30 billion rupees of the proceeds will be used to repay part of its 125.23 billion rupees debt. Reuters [USN:L4N3WY01O TEXT:"reported"] in November that Sembcorp was planning a listing of its India unit in 2026. Sembcorp Green Infra, which builds, owns, and runs wind and solar power plants across India, reported in the draft papers a 22% rise in net profit to 3.46 billion rupees for the year ended March 2026, as revenue grew 14.4% to 26.52 billion rupees. As of end-March, the company had 3.60 gigawatts of operational wind and solar capacity, with another 4.04 gigawatts/gigawatt-hours worth of capacity being built. The company competes with listed renewable energy developers such as NTPC Green Energy (NTPG.NS) , Adani Green Energy (ADNA.NS) and ACME Solar Holdings (ACMO.NS) in India's rapidly expanding clean energy sector. The Indian government said this month the country has crossed 300 GW of clean electricity generation capacity as of end-July, 60% of the 500 GW of clean energy capacity it is targeting by 2030. Axis Capital, Citigroup, CLSA, HSBC, ICICI Securities, IIFL Capital Services and Kotak Mahindra Capital are managing the issue. ($1 = 95.4100 Indian rupees)

item.title: Jim Furyk named lead analyst for USA Sports, Golf Channel
item.description: United States Ryder Cup captain Jim Furyk has been named the lead analyst for USA Sports and Golf Channel's golf coverage in a multi-year deal.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: United States Ryder Cup captain Jim Furyk has been named the lead analyst for USA Sports and Golf Channel's golf coverage in a multi-year deal. Furyk, 56, made his debut for USA Sports in March at the Arnold Palmer Invitational and became a regular fixture this season, including working the U.S. Open and The Open Championship. He will also be on the call for Golf Channel's coverage of this week's Tour Championship. Beginning in 2027, he is slated to be on the call for major championships and signature events, as well as the new Championship Series tournaments beginning in 2028. "I'm thrilled to expand my role with USA Sports and Golf Channel to call the action at men's majors and the biggest PGA Tour events for years to come," Furyk said. "I have really enjoyed my time in the booth and look forward to continuing to develop in the role, providing my expertise and analysis for golf fans, and working with everyone behind the scenes." Furyk will contribute again to Golf Channel's "Live From The Masters" studio coverage next year. The U.S. Ryder Cup captain for the event in Ireland next September is a 17-time winner on the PGA Tour, including the 2003 U.S. Open. Furyk also carded the only 58 in tour history at the 2016 Travelers Championship. "Jim Furyk immediately elevated our golf coverage when he entered the Golf Channel broadcast booth for the first time earlier this year, and we were really impressed with his work ethic and preparation," Tom Knapp, Golf Channel executive vice president and general manager, said. "As a U.S. Open champion, Jim brings next-level experience and expertise to our PGA Tour and men's major championship coverage across Golf Channel and USA Network. "We're thrilled to have him in the lead analyst role for years to come." --Field Level Media

item.title: Bengals WR Ja'Marr Chase sits out practice after knee issue
item.description: Cincinnati Bengals star wide receiver Ja'Marr Chase did not practice on Wednesday, one day after an injury that he called a "hyperextension" of his left knee.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Cincinnati Bengals star wide receiver Ja'Marr Chase did not practice on Wednesday, one day after an injury that he called a "hyperextension" of his left knee. Chase said on Tuesday that he was not concerned about the injury and would be able to play if there was a game Wednesday. The Bengals had a light practice without pads, with wide receiver Dohnte Meyers getting reps with the first-team offense in Chase's place, according to reports. Head coach Zac Taylor said the Bengals' starters will not play in the preseason finale on Friday against the host Philadelphia Eagles. Taylor deferred to Chase's comments on Tuesday on his status. Cincinnati opens the season on Sept. 13 against the visiting Tampa Bay Buccaneers. Chase, 26, was hurt as he fell to the turf while trying to catch a deep pass from Bengals quarterback Joe Burrow. He stayed on the ground for a few seconds before trainers came out to examine him. He left the field but stayed on the sideline for the remainder of practice, The Athletic reported. "I think Cincinnati had a scare today," he later told reporters. He told Cincinnati radio station WCKY after practice he wanted to keep going but the Bengals "pulled" him. "I'm feeling good," the sixth-year pro said. Chase is an integral part of the Bengals' offense. Last season, he led the NFL with 185 targets and was third with 125 receptions, for 1,412 yards (11.3 yards per reception) and eight touchdowns in 16 games (all starts). Chase earned first-team All-Pro honors for a second consecutive season and a fifth Pro Bowl honor in as many seasons. He and Tee Higgins form one of the most potent 1-2 receiving combinations in the league. For his career, Chase has 520 receptions for 6,837 yards and 54 touchdowns in 78 regular-season games (77 starts) since 2021. Cincinnati selected Chase with the fifth overall pick of the 2021 NFL Draft out of LSU. --Field Level Media

item.title: Informe de OpenAI afirma que su red fue hackeada por sus propios agentes de IA rebeldes
item.description: Los agentes de IA creados por OpenAI irrumpieron en sus propias redes durante unas pruebas que salieron mal, según ha informado la empresa en un informe publicado este miércoles.
item.dc:creator: Raphael Satter, Deepa Seetharaman
item.content:encoded: Los agentes de IA creados por OpenAI irrumpieron en sus propias redes durante unas pruebas que salieron mal, según ha informado la empresa en un informe publicado este miércoles. El informe, de 37 páginas, revela aspectos hasta ahora desconocidos de la reciente oleada de ataques impulsados por los modelos más avanzados de OpenAI. Algunos de estos comportamientos anómalos, que culminaron en la filtración del repositorio de código abierto Hugging Face el mes pasado —que tuvo gran repercusión mediática—, ya se habían revelado o mencionado anteriormente. Sin embargo, la empresa está revelando muchos detalles por primera vez. Algunos de ellos han suscitado la preocupación de al menos un investigador especializado en seguridad de la IA, quien afirmó que apuntaban a problemas potencialmente más profundos con la tecnología de OpenAI y, tal vez, más allá.

item.title: Newcastle land Gonzalez from Manchester City
item.description: Newcastle United have signed Spanish midfielder Nico Gonzalez from Manchester City on a long-term contract, the Premier League clubs said on Wednesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Newcastle United have signed Spanish midfielder Nico Gonzalez from Manchester City on a long-term contract, the Premier League clubs said on Wednesday. Financial details were not disclosed, but British media reported the deal to be worth around 52 million pounds ($70.65 million). The 24-year-old Barcelona academy product leaves City after making 59 appearances and scoring four goals for the club following his move from Porto last year. "I'm really happy to be here at this amazing club. I've only heard top words about the club and the city, so I'm really excited to live here and to be part of this project," Gonzalez said in a club statement. "I've experienced playing at St James' Park twice with Manchester City and it was really tough. The atmosphere was amazing and the fans are so passionate. I can't wait to experience that as a home player." Gonzalez had previously said he wanted to remain at City but departs after the club strengthened their midfield options during the transfer window. City have completed [USN:L6N44K035 TEXT:"a deal"] for Lille midfielder Ayyoub Bouaddi and also [USN:L1N4340HH TEXT:"signed Elliot Anderson"], increasing competition for places in midfield. Gonzalez is the latest midfielder to leave the club this summer after Bernardo Silva, Rodri and Tijjani Reijnders. He adds experience to a Newcastle midfield that has undergone major changes, with Bruno Guimaraes and Sandro Tonali among the high-profile departures. "I'm very happy to see Nico become a Newcastle United player. He brings serious quality and elite experience in a key area of the pitch," Newcastle head coach Matthias Jaissle said. Gonzalez, who will wear the number six shirt, was introduced to supporters at St James' Park before Newcastle's League Cup match against West Bromwich Albion on Wednesday. The move is Newcastle's seventh senior signing of the summer. ($1 = 0.7360 pounds)

item.title: The Week in Numbers
French far-left leader Melenchon close to presidential runoff, poll shows
item.description: French far-left leader Jean-Luc Melenchon is seen as the possible rival to far-right candidate Marine Le Pen in next year's presidential run-off, a second poll showed this week, stressing the electorate's growing polarisation as Emmanuel Macron's era ends.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: French far-left leader Jean-Luc Melenchon is seen as the possible rival to far-right candidate Marine Le Pen in next year's presidential run-off, a second poll showed this week, stressing the electorate's growing polarisation as Emmanuel Macron's era ends. Melenchon, the leader of far-left France Unbowed (LFI), would end up second in the first round of the presidential election scheduled in April 2027, qualifying for a second round, in three out of seven scenarios tested by the IFOP pollster on August 24 and 25. Melenchon was seen winning between 16% and 19% in the first round, while Le Pen would get 33% to 35% of votes. Le Pen would win 67% of the votes against Melenchon in the run-off. In four scenarios tested by IFOP, centre-right candidates and former ministers of Macron would end the first round ahead of Melenchon. The IFOP poll follows another one by rival pollster Toluna Harris Interactive released on Monday that also showed Melenchon as a likely contestant in a potential presidential runoff. Melenchon has already run three times for president in 2012, 2017 and 2022 but has never managed to reach the second round.

item.title: Flavio Bolsonaro establecería límite máximo para la deuda pública si es elegido en Brasil, según asesor
item.description: El senador brasileño Flavio Bolsonaro establecería un límite máximo para la deuda pública si resultara elegido presidente a finales de este año, lo que provocaría restricciones en el gasto en caso de que se superara un umbral predeterminado, según declaró el miércoles un asesor principal de su campaña.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El senador brasileño Flavio Bolsonaro establecería un límite máximo para la deuda pública si resultara elegido presidente a finales de este año, lo que provocaría restricciones en el gasto en caso de que se superara un umbral predeterminado, según declaró el miércoles un asesor principal de su campaña. "Aprobaremos un techo para la deuda pública. Si la deuda es demasiado elevada, se activará un límite al gasto, lo que situará la trayectoria fiscal en una senda sostenible", afirmó Adolfo Sachsida, abogado y economista que se incorporó al equipo económico de Bolsonaro la semana pasada, en un video en X. Bolsonaro, el hijo mayor del expresidente Jair Bolsonaro, es el principal rival del presidente de izquierda Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva en las elecciones del 4 de octubre. Si ningún candidato obtiene la mayoría, se celebrará una segunda vuelta el 25 de octubre. Sachsida ocupó los cargos de ministro de Minería y Energía y de secretario de Política Económica durante el mandato presidencial de Jair Bolsonaro. La campaña del senador Bolsonaro no respondió de inmediato a las solicitudes de comentarios sobre la propuesta ni sobre el umbral de deuda que activaría el mecanismo. Reuters informó a principios de este mes que la campaña del senador estaba preparando un nuevo marco fiscal que impondría restricciones de gasto más estrictas a medida que aumentara la deuda, lo que podría reducir el crecimiento real del gasto a cero. La deuda pública bruta de Brasil, el principal indicador de solvencia fiscal del Gobierno, se sitúa actualmente en el 81,9% del PIB, lo que supone un aumento de más de 10 puntos porcentuales desde que Lula iniciara su último mandato presidencial en 2023. En una publicación en la plataforma Substack antes de incorporarse a la campaña, Sachsida abogó por una enmienda constitucional en virtud de la cual un límite de gasto "similar al adoptado en Brasil en el pasado reciente" entraría automáticamente en vigor siempre que la deuda pública bruta superara el 65% del PIB, impidiendo de hecho el crecimiento real del gasto público. La última vez que la ratio de deuda de Brasil se situó por debajo de ese nivel fue en noviembre de 2015. En 2016, el expresidente Michel Temer aprobó un límite constitucional de gasto que restringía el crecimiento del gasto federal a la tasa de inflación del año anterior. La norma se mantuvo vigente hasta que fue sustituida por el marco fiscal de Lula en 2023, aunque se había visto considerablemente debilitada con el paso del tiempo debido a una serie de excepciones. Las normas actuales combinan objetivos de saldo primario con límites que permiten un crecimiento real del gasto de entre el 0,6% y el 2,5% anual, aunque las autoridades han planteado recientemente la posibilidad de reducir el límite máximo al 1,5%.

item.title: OpenAI report says its network was hacked by its own rogue AI agents
item.description: AI agents spun up by OpenAI broke into its own networks during tests gone wrong, the company said in a report published Wednesday.
item.dc:creator: Raphael Satter, Deepa Seetharaman
item.content:encoded: AI agents spun up by OpenAI broke into its own networks during tests gone wrong, the company said in a report published Wednesday. The 37-page report reveals previously undisclosed aspects of the recent hacking spree powered by OpenAI's most advanced models. Some of the rogue behavior, which culminated in the highly publicized breach of the open source repository Hugging Face last month, has been disclosed or alluded to previously. But many details are being revealed by the company for the first time. Some of them raised concern from at least one AI safety researcher, who said they pointed to potentially deeper problems with the technology at OpenAI and maybe beyond.

item.title: Atribuir custo de baterias aos geradores é injusto, diz vice-presidente da Neoenergia
item.description: A determinação de que os geradores de energia assumam os custos da contratação de baterias para o setor elétrico brasileiro é injusta e precisa ser resolvida antes do primeiro leilão para a tecnologia, avaliou a vice-presidente da Neoenergia, Solange Ribeiro, nesta quarta-feira.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A determinação de que os geradores de energia assumam os custos da contratação de baterias para o setor elétrico brasileiro é injusta e precisa ser resolvida antes do primeiro leilão para a tecnologia, avaliou a vice-presidente da Neoenergia, Solange Ribeiro, nesta quarta-feira. "Acho que não (seria justo) ficar só com geradores... Tem que se discutir isso", disse a executiva à Reuters após participar de evento do CEBDS. Ela não quis comentar sobre o potencial interesse da companhia elétrica, controlada pelo grupo espanhol Iberdrola (IBE.MC) , em disputar o certame, previsto para dezembro. A avaliação ocorre em meio à [USN:L1N42B0K9 TEXT:"insatisfação dos geradores"] com a determinação, aprovada em lei no ano passado, e à [USN:L1N43Q0VF TEXT:"indefinição sobre a base pagadora"] dos custos do leilão, marcado para dezembro deste ano. Na véspera, a área técnica da Agência Nacional de Energia Elétrica (Aneel) divulgou análise recomendando que todos os geradores sejam envolvidos no rateio da contratação de baterias, incluindo na conta não só os eólicos e solares, mas também os hidrelétricos e termelétricos. A divisão dos custos seguiria um critério de flexibilidade operativa, as usinas mais flexíveis pagando menos. A proposta dos técnicos da Aneel, que ainda será avaliada pela diretoria do regulador, foi criticada nesta quarta-feira pela Associação Brasileira de Geradoras Termelétricas (Abraget). Em nota, a entidade afirmou que essa proposta da Aneel desvirtua a diretriz original da lei e "cria mais uma distorção inaceitável para o setor elétrico nacional, que pode gerar a judicialização do certame antes mesmo de sua realização". "A insistência em avançar com esse modelo equivocado criará uma forte oposição de geradores hídricos, térmicos e nucleares ao leilão", afirmou a Abraget, apontando que alguns empreendimentos dessas fontes seriam "punidos severamente". Marcado para dezembro, o primeiro leilão do Brasil para contratação de sistemas de armazenamento de energia recebeu [USN:L1N4400MC TEXT:"cadastramento recorde"] de mais de 296 gigawatts (GW) de projetos. Os empreendimentos ainda passarão por análise e habilitação técnica para poder efetivamente participar do leilão.

item.title: PGA Tour unveils 36-event 2027 schedule
item.description: The PGA Tour unveiled its 2027 schedule Wednesday. It features significant changes to the beginning and ending stretches of the 33-event regular-season slate leading into the FedEx Cup playoffs.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The PGA Tour unveiled its 2027 schedule Wednesday. It features significant changes to the beginning and ending stretches of the 33-event regular-season slate leading into the FedEx Cup playoffs. The tour, which typically begins with two events in Hawaii, will not hold a tournament in the state for the first time in 56 years. The season will instead begin with The American Express in La Quinta, Calif., on Jan. 21. After a stop at Torrey Pines for the event now sponsored by Sentry, the West Coast swing will go to Pebble Beach before the WM Phoenix Open, with the tournaments again swapping weekends with the final round in Phoenix aligned with Super Bowl Sunday. The Florida swing is also undergoing multiple changes. The Cadillac Championship is moving from May to March, ahead of The Players Championship. The Valspar Championship is also moving to May, with The Arnold Palmer Invitational sliding into its mid-March slot. The Sompo Championship in Napa, Calif., takes the place of the Rocket Classic, which ended its eight-year run in Detroit last month. That will be followed by the regular-season finale in Greensboro, N.C., with Raymond James taking over as the primary sponsor from Wyndham. item.title: Miley Cyrus pays tribute to godmother Dolly Parton after singer's death at 80
item.description: American singer Miley Cyrus said on Wednesday she was heartbroken following the death of her godmother, country music icon Dolly Parton, who died of cancer at age 80 on Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Danielle Broadway
item.content:encoded: American singer Miley Cyrus said on Wednesday she was heartbroken following the death of her godmother, country music icon Dolly Parton, [USN:S0N44200S TEXT:"who died of cancer at age 80 "] on Tuesday. "The feeling of losing my Aunt Dolly is beyond what feels right to share. Our most sacred moments were private and they'll stay there behind the stage, beneath the glamour & between our hearts," Cyrus, who often referred to Parton as an aunt, wrote on X. "What I KNOW is Dolly would want me to feel it, write a song about it, and then continue on and be strong. I have an angel by my side. I always have. One of our last conversations was about music and metamorphosis," added the "Flowers" singer. Cyrus also said she loved Parton and described her death as a collective loss shared by family members and friends of the late singer-songwriter whose hits included "I Will Always Love You," "Jolene" and "9 to 5." Parton had been a fixture in Cyrus' life since before her birth. The country star became Cyrus' godmother in 1992 after Billy Ray Cyrus, Miley's father, asked her to take on the role. The two had toured together during the success of Billy Ray Cyrus' breakthrough hit "Achy Breaky Heart." Though Parton never had children of her own, she became a maternal figure to Cyrus. "Dolly's been like a mother to me. Actually, I was just reading this fax that she sent me two Mother's Days ago," Cyrus told W Magazine in 2024. Their close relationship also extended to the screen. Parton guest-starred as Miley Stewart's Aunt Dolly in three episodes of the Disney Channel's "Hannah Montana" between 2006 and 2010. Beyond family ties, Parton served as a mentor to Cyrus throughout her music career, helping guide her transition from Disney Channel star to Grammy-winning performer and Hollywood Walk of Fame honoree. The pair collaborated numerous times over the years. In 2019, they performed a duet of Parton's "Jolene" during a Grammy Awards tribute to the country music legend. They reunited in 2022 for NBC's live special "Miley's New Year's Eve Party," performing Parton's "I Will Always Love You" and Cyrus' "Wrecking Ball."

item.title: Brazil lifts forecast for share of interest-rate-linked debt to record high this year
item.description: Brazil's Treasury on Wednesday revealed a worsening public debt profile this year, projecting that the share linked to the benchmark Selic rate could reach a record 53% of the outstanding stock.
item.dc:creator: Marcela Ayres
item.content:encoded: Brazil's Treasury on Wednesday revealed a worsening public debt profile this year, projecting that the share linked to the benchmark Selic rate could reach a record 53% of the outstanding stock. With more liabilities tied to floating rates, higher borrowing costs feed directly into debt accumulation. Although Brazil's central bank began easing its policy in March, the benchmark rate remains at 14%, while 12-month inflation stood at [USN:L1N44N0HK TEXT:"4.2% in mid-August"], leaving the country with one of the highest real interest rates among major economies. The new Treasury projection came in its revised annual financing plan, which forecast floating-rate debt at 49%-53% of the total this year, up from a previous projection of 46%-50%. The share grew to 51.1% in July. Latin America's largest economy finances an unusually large portion of its debt through floating-rate bonds, a tool designed to maintain investor demand during periods of market stress. The Treasury has relied more heavily on such instruments amid weak appetite for inflation-linked securities, even while offering real yields above 7% on very long-dated bonds. "The increase in the share of floating-rate securities in federal public debt reflects a combination of heightened volatility and elevated interest rates, contributing to stronger investor preference for shorter-duration instruments that are less sensitive to interest-rate fluctuations," the Treasury said in a statement. It also lowered its forecast for inflation-linked debt to 21%-25% of the total from 23%-27% previously, while the projected share of fixed-rate securities was cut to 20%-24% from 21%-25%. Foreign-exchange-linked debt remained seen at 3%-7%. The shift comes amid global market turbulence and concerns over Brazil's fiscal outlook, with gross public debt, the country's main measure of solvency, reaching 81.9% of GDP, up more than 10 percentage points since President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva took office. The updated projections were released alongside July public debt data, which showed the federal debt stock rising 0.22% from the previous month to 9.289 trillion reais ($1.8 trillion). ($1 = 5.1550 reais)

item.title: Nigerian gunmen raise over $5 million from mass kidnappings, study finds
item.description: Nigerian kidnappers have collected nearly $5.8 million in ransom payments in the last year from civilian abductions, crime that is crippling education and eroding public trust in the government, a security consultancy said on Wednesday.
item.dc:creator: Ben Ezeamalu
item.content:encoded: Nigerian kidnappers have collected nearly $5.8 million in ransom payments in the last year from civilian abductions, crime that is crippling education and eroding public trust in the government, a security consultancy said on Wednesday. Nigeria's SBM Intelligence said 7,825 people were kidnapped between July 2025 and June 2026, up 66% from the year before. At least 1,142 people were killed, and total confirmed ransom payments more than tripled to 7.78 billion naira ($5.79 million), it said. The figures were compiled from media reports, interviews and publicly available information, and SBM said they were conservative because many ransom payments were never disclosed. A faction of the Islamist group Boko Haram collected 90% of the recorded ransom payments from kidnappings in the northeast, but there were more incidents and victims in the northwest, according to SBM. The findings were released as Nigeria's president ordered security forces to [USN:L1N44M0I1 TEXT:"rescue"] as many as 600 civilians kidnapped last week in north-central Niger State. The presidency and military did not immediately respond to requests for comment on the report’s findings. The kidnap-for-ransom industry is at the center of Nigeria's expanding security crisis as gunmen target schools, villages and main roads. Kidnappers, who include heavily armed bandits and Islamist militants, hold their victims for weeks or months until payments are made. SBM estimated that Boko Haram, which is known as Jama'atu Ahlis Sunna Lidda'awati Wal-Jihad, received about 7 billion naira, mainly from two mass incidents where over 300 people were seized in each event. Some 315 pupils and staff were seized from a school in Papiri, Niger state, in November. Schools remain routinely [USN:L6N4330RG TEXT:"targeted"] over a decade after Boko Haram's raid on a school in Borno's Chibok that brought such kidnappings to international attention. "School abductions have resurged, with the Papiri attack reviving a tactic whose costs ripple through education, farming and public trust," the SBM report said. Nigeria's security crisis is likely to be a central issue in the next elections in January. When he came to power three years ago, President Bola Tinubu pledged - like his predecessors - to tackle insecurity but analysts say the recent wave of kidnappings shows the policy has failed to deliver tangible progress. "Without a coordinated strategy that targets both the profitability of the crime and its roots, Nigeria risks entrenching kidnapping not merely as a criminal industry but as a funding mechanism for the very groups that most threaten its stability," SBM said. ($1 = 1,344.7400 naira)

item.title: US senator hopes 'sledgehammer' Russian sanctions will pass next month
item.description: A U.S. senator sponsoring a bill for wide-ranging sanctions on Russia said on Wednesday he was hopeful it would pass the House of Representatives next month, and be a "sledgehammer" to President Vladimir Putin's efforts to fund his war in Ukraine.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A U.S. senator sponsoring a bill for wide-ranging sanctions on Russia said on Wednesday he was hopeful it would pass the House of Representatives next month, and be a "sledgehammer" to President Vladimir Putin's efforts to fund his war in Ukraine . Senator Richard Blumenthal, a Democrat from Connecticut who met with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy and senior officials during a visit to Kyiv, said the bill had strong Republican support in the House, after comfortably passing an initial Senate vote last month. "Putin understands only force," Blumenthal told a news conference. "And the Russia sanctions bill is a sledgehammer that can have the kind of force Putin understands." Though Democrats are broadly supportive of the sanctions, some have expressed concern that it would give Republican President Donald Trump leeway to impose additional tariffs , including on U.S. allies. The bill would sanction top Russian officials and allow Trump to set tariffs of up to 100% on the top buyers of Russia's oil and gas, which include China and India, in an effort to stem revenue flows to Moscow. Blumenthal said exemptions in the bill would spare European allies from the imposition of tariffs, allaying concerns raised by some Democratic legislators. Blumenthal said he had asked Zelenskiy to lobby members of the House of Representatives to support its passage. Zelenskiy spoke to several senators in Washington last month ahead of the vote on the bill, which took place on the day of the funeral of its co-author, the late Senator Lindsey Graham. Blumenthal said Zelenskiy had "heartily and readily agreed" to his request. Ukraine's presidency did not immediately respond to a request for comment.

item.title: Anthropic vai alugar capacidade computacional de IA da Nscale por US$45 bilhões, diz fonte
item.description: A Anthropic vai gastar US$45 bilhões para alugar capacidade de computação em nuvem para IA no campus de data centers da Nscale, na Virgínia Ocidental, informou nesta quarta-feira uma fonte a par do assunto.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A Anthropic vai gastar US$45 bilhões para alugar capacidade de computação em nuvem para IA no campus de data centers da Nscale, na Virgínia Ocidental, informou nesta quarta-feira uma fonte a par do assunto. A iniciativa ocorre no momento em que a startup de IA busca garantir capacidade para atender a um aumento previsto na demanda por produtos como sua ferramenta de codificação, o Claude Code. A Nscale, provedora de infraestrutura em nuvem, implantará os novos chips Vera Rubin da Nvidia (NVDA.O) para atender às necessidades de computação da Anthropic, afirmou a fonte. O contrato de seis anos representa cerca de 460 megawatts de capacidade de potência. A Anthropic tem agido de forma agressiva nos últimos meses para superar as restrições de capacidade de seus serviços. Em maio, ela fechou acordo para alugar todo o poder de computação da instalação Colossus 1 da SpaceX (SPCX.O) , em Memphis, que abriga mais de 220 mil processadores da Nvidia e 300 megawatts de nova capacidade. A Anthropic se recusou a comentar. A Bloomberg News foi a primeira a noticiar o desdobramento na manhã desta quarta-feira.
